name: George Akkawi

His expertise in Logistics and Supply Chain Solution is evident through his exceptional work ethic and innovative approach to problem-solving. Mohammad consistently delivers high-quality results and demonstrates excellent leadership and teamwork abilities. His commitment to continuous learning and improvement makes him a valuable asset to any team. I highly recommend Mohammad for any opportunity that allows him to leverage his impressive skills and knowledge.
